landscaping.seoDescription: Garden and green space design — softscape, hardscape, smart irrigation, and maintenance for residential, commercial, and government projects.
landscaping.introDescription: This sector focuses on beautifying and organizing outdoor spaces for residential, commercial, and government projects, including softscape, hardscape, modern irrigation systems, and maintenance & operations.
landscaping.introDescriptionEn: This sector focuses on beautifying and organizing outdoor spaces for residential, commercial, and government projects, including softscape, hardscape, modern irrigation systems, and maintenance & operations.

defaultTypes.name: Softscape
defaultTypes.desc: Large trees: supply and planting of mature trees, palms, and shade trees. Shrubs & ornamentals: decorative trees, shrubs, and flowers. Turf & ground cover: natural and artificial green surfaces.
defaultTypes.descEn: Large trees: supply and planting of mature trees, palms, and shade trees. Shrubs & ornamentals: decorative trees, shrubs, and flowers. Turf & ground cover: natural and artificial green surfaces.

defaultTypes.name: Irrigation Systems
defaultTypes.desc: Supply and installation of drip and sprinkler networks. Electric irrigation valves, filters, and decoder programming. Pumps and control units to optimize water consumption.
defaultTypes.descEn: Supply and installation of drip and sprinkler networks. Electric irrigation valves, filters, and decoder programming. Pumps and control units to optimize water consumption.

defaultTypes.name: Hardscape
defaultTypes.desc: Stamped concrete for paths and outdoor plazas. Rubber flooring for sports walkways and play areas. Playgrounds, sports facilities, shades, benches, tables, and waste bins.
defaultTypes.descEn: Stamped concrete for paths and outdoor plazas. Rubber flooring for sports walkways and play areas. Playgrounds, sports facilities, shades, benches, tables, and waste bins.

defaultTypes.name: Maintenance & Operations
defaultTypes.desc: Mowing, renovation, and fertilization of green areas. Tree pruning, pesticide spraying, and rehabilitation of irrigation networks.
defaultTypes.descEn: Mowing, renovation, and fertilization of green areas. Tree pruning, pesticide spraying, and rehabilitation of irrigation networks.
